title: At the intersection of structure, stage and voice
lead: Civil engineer, TV presenter & master of ceremonies, public speaking coach — one presence at the service of your projects.

story.p1: Trained as a civil engineer, Giovani learned to read reality as a system: loads, constraints, balance. That same rigor now shapes his media presence and coaching method.
story.p2: As a TV presenter and master of ceremonies, he turns every speaking moment into a memorable experience — timing, warmth, and mastery of silence.
story.p3: As a coach, he helps leaders, creators and emerging talents find a clear, credible and embodied voice.

experience.title: Professional path
experience.subtitle: A timeline of roles, impact and presence — from site to stage, from structure to voice.

items.text: Coaching for executives, sales teams and emerging talents. COMEX workshops, pitch sessions and high-pressure delivery — clear method: message structure, stage presence, actionable feedback.
Hosting shows, ceremonies and corporate events. Live interviews and rhythm management on air — stage signature: precision, warmth, elegance.
Technical support on structures, sites and execution follow-up. Coordination with clients and stakeholders — structural rigor applied to every delivery.

Broadcast techniques, event hosting and stage presence.
Pedagogy, feedback and confidence-building for speakers.
